title: Measured exact memory acceleration precision audit
purpose: Quantify current fast-path floating-point drift against burst/page reference loops.
scope_limit: These are software equivalence measurements for listed representative configurations, not guarantees for all configurations and not calibration against physical hardware.

method.dram_reference: DramCore subclass with _can_accelerate() == False, using burst execution.
method.nand_reference: NandCore subclass overriding _execute_accepted() to call _execute_detailed_accepted(), using page execution.
method.dram_numeric_reference: For DRAM cases, the compiled wrapper is also run with tools/precision_dram_reference.py run_numeric_serial, which visits each burst without row-cycle folding; this is compared against the original Python per-burst reference.
method.comparison: Measured per-request completion_ns and final resource calendars/busy/state; integer byte and operation counters are compared exactly and any mismatch fails the script.
method.relative_error_denominator: abs(reference value); if reference is zero and actual is zero relative error is 0; if reference is zero and actual is nonzero, the value is counted separately and relative_error is null.
method.duration_relative_error_denominator: For each request, abs(reference_completion_ns - request.arrival_ns); completion timestamp relative error separately uses abs(reference_completion_ns).
method.floating_point_error_policy: No tolerance is used to hide the measurement. Absolute and relative deltas are saved as observed IEEE-754 results.

physical_config_observation.native_rtx_preset: Declares physical_memory_config for GDDR7 only. Its hostmem0 is the Samsung DDR5-5600 component preset but has no physical_memory_config field.
physical_config_observation.native_ddr5_audit: Included as a separately labeled derived representative configuration based on the declared DDR5-5600 throughput; its geometry/timings are not claimed as native physical config.
physical_config_observation.b200_presets: Both B200 architecture presets have no physical_memory_config on their HBF/HBM/other components, so no physical acceleration error is claimed for those presets.

metadata.command_interval_basis: burst_bytes / (pin_data_rate_gbps * data_width_bits / 8); analytical scheduling budget, not JEDEC timing

metadata.audit_basis: derived from native Samsung DDR5-5600 module throughput; geometry/timing are representative, not declared physical_memory_config
